FLASHCARD SET · AGES 2 YEARS

Garden Things flashcards.

Twelve cards about the things a garden holds: the tree at the gate, the watering can, the wheelbarrow with the big wheel. Everyday garden words, ready to name together.

These cards belong to School Garden · Age 2 on the Kiddo School learning path.

THE CARDS

Every card in the set.

Each card has its own page: the picture and short, practical notes for grown-ups — what it is for, how to use it, how to print it. Tap any card to open it.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Four ways that work.

You do not need a plan or a printer schedule. Pick one idea, try it for two minutes and see what happens.

  1. 01

    Name it on the way

    Carry two or three cards on your walk — the tree card, the bench card — and tick them off when you pass the real thing. Garden words live on every street.

  2. 02

    Do what the thing does

    Water like a watering can, dig like a shovel, push an invisible wheelbarrow. Tool names stick when little arms do the job in miniature.

  3. 03

    Spot the letter shapes

    Garden things are big and simple — a fence is lines, a bush is a circle, a tree is a line with a cloud on top. Point them out; drawing comes later for free.

  4. 04

    Grown-up tools, toddler words

    The shovel and rake stay in grown-up hands, and that is the game: your toddler names them, points at them, and does the toddler version with a spoon.
